title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT

A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your

A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. About Doximity 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will:

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates.

- Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours.

What We're Looking For 

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

Must have: 

- Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients.

- Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships.

- Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA.

- Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have: 

- Working knowledge of statistics and visualization.

- Experience working with data visualization tools.

- Advanced Excel skills.

- Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows.

- Experience working in the healthcare industry.

- Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Large Enterprise
description:
About the Team 

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role 

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees 

In this role, you will: 

- Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

- Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

- Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

- Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

- Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

- Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

- Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

- Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you: 

- Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

- Are fluent in both German and English

- Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

- Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

- Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

- Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

- Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

- Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

- Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

- Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

About OpenAI 

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres
description:
Headquarters: Remote

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

- You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

- You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

- You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

- You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

- You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

- You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

- You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

- You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

- You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

- You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

- 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

- Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

- Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

- Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

- Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. title: Dev Ops Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting 

Smarkets runs one of the world’s most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We’re a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting - from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

Our stack is designed for scale, reliability, and speed: Linux, Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, with Python 3, C++17, and React powering our platform. We build infrastructure that institutions trust while keeping trading accessible to everyone. Our edge? We’ve thrived through every market cycle, competitor, and industry revolution.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you’re ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

About the Role 

You’ll join the DevOps Infrastructure Team, responsible for real-time distributed systems that power our trading engine-systems that are always-on, ultra-low latency, and demand resilience at scale.

You won’t just be building infrastructure-you’ll be crafting platform capabilities to streamline how engineers build, test, deploy, and run applications across our hybrid estate of self-hosted, co-located hardware and AWS cloud.

This is a role where infrastructure meets engineering productivity: part DevOps, part Platform, 100% mission-critical.

What You’ll Do 

- Platform Enablement: Design and maintain internal tooling and workflows that improve the developer experience across deployment pipelines, observability and testing environments.

- Empower Developers (DevEx): Automate workflows, streamline CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab), and ensure fast, safe, and reliable deployments across environments.

- Infrastructure Automation: Build, manage, and scale Kubernetes-based microservices infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.

- Developer Experience: Collaborate closely with product engineers to provide reliable, low-friction paths for development, testing, and deployment.

- Operational Excellence: Monitor, debug, and ensure the stability of our systems with robust alerting and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.

- System Reliability: Optimize performance and availability for high-throughput, low-latency services that power the betting exchange.

- Collaborative Delivery: Participate in on-call rotations, incident reviews, and cross-functional projects with engineering and SRE teams.

- Security & Compliance: Contribute to secure system design and operational practices that support industry-standard compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc).

What You Bring 

- 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering roles.

- Strong Linux systems administration background.

- Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting.

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS (or other public clouds).

- Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and production-scale deployment.

- Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and a passion for improving the build/deploy process.

- A pragmatic mindset that balances ideal solutions with immediate business needs.

- Curiosity and initiative to explore new technologies and bring fresh thinking into the team.

Bonus Points For 

- Exposure to Nix-based Build environments.

- Understanding of self-hosted or hybrid infrastructure models.

- Experience with ArgoCD, Backstage or internal developer portals.

- Knowledge of Rust or C++ environments.

- Interest in performance engineering and low-latency systems.

Our Stack 

- Languages: Python, Bash, Rust, NodeJS

- Datastores: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka

- Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nix, Jenkins, GitLab CI

- Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Sentry

Our Values 

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

- Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

- Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

- Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

- Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

- Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits 
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

- Stock Options : Vest over 4 years, your success is our success.

- Pension Scheme : Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

- Enhanced Parental Leave : Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life’s most important moments.

- Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food.

- Cycle-to-Work Scheme : Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

- Learning & Development : £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

- Holiday : 25 days paid leave + bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

- Flexible Working : Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

- Global Working: Work from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days a year.

- Team Energy : Regular socials, hackathons, and events — because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

title: Research and Development Engineer in Formal Methods - 12 months contract
description:
Who we are ? 

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios.

A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines.

Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool.

Your main responsibilities will include : 

- Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification

- Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English.

Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset.

The candidate must demonstrate good team spirit, rigour, organisational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as strong communication and technical writing skills.

Education and experience : Master’s degree (Bac+5) or equivalent; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+4) with at least 4 years’ experience; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+3) with 6 years’ experience; or a two-year higher education qualification (Bac+2) with 10 years’ professional experience.

Why join us? 
You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from :

- 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT)

Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Please note: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector.

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect 

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us ! 

- Discover our company culture and values 

- Here is a product teaser 

- Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle 

- Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest 

- Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog )

Vocca in a few words 

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

- $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

- Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

- Opening the US market

The problem 

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own 

- The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

- Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

- The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

- The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

- The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build 

- Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

- Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

- AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

- Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack 

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here 

- 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

- You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

- You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

- Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

- You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

- You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you 

- First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

- First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

- First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

- 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

Process: 4 steps, fast 

- 45 min with Nans (Talent).

- 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

- 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

- 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical 

- Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

- Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

- BSPCE.

- Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca? 

- An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

- A true scaling phase , with everything still to build

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
description:
Worum geht es?

Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung.

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

- Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

- Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

- Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

- Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

- Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

- Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

- Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

- Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

- Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

- Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

- Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

- Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

- PostgreSQL und Redis

- Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

- Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

- REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

- KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium.

- Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten.

- Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge.

- 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

- Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab.

- Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern.

Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit

Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA.

Vergütung

Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

So läuft die Bewerbung ab

- Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an.

- Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon.

- Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis.

- Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag.

- Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch.

Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your Mission 

Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich or Berlin .
You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. This means you will see the impact of your work immediately - not at some point in the distant future.

Your Responsibilities 

- Security Architecture & Cloud Guardrails: You will take technical ownership of the security architecture and controls across our Azure environment - from Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel to Log Analytics. You will build and maintain the corresponding guardrails directly in Terraform.

- Detection Engineering: You will develop and continuously improve our detections in close collaboration with our Security Analyst, who is responsible for day-to-day SIEM monitoring and triage. You will work as a well-coordinated team rather than in separate silos.

- Vulnerability Management: You will further develop our vulnerability management and monitoring across a hybrid environment. This includes our growing cloud landscape as well as the existing on-premises stack for as long as the migration is ongoing.

- Security Beyond the Cloud: You will contribute your expertise beyond cloud security, including identity, endpoint security, application security, incident response, and AI. Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes.

- AI-Assisted Engineering: You will use tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain internal security tools and automations. At the same time, you will help us identify AI-specific risks early—from the secure use of AI coding assistants to prompt injection.

Your Skillset 

- Azure Security & Certifications: You have at least five years of experience in security engineering and several years of hands-on experience implementing Azure security. You hold an AZ-500 certification or have equivalent practical expertise. SC-100, CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certifications are a plus.

- Infrastructure & Automation: You can confidently read, write, and further develop security-related Terraform code. Experience with Python, Django, PowerShell, or AI-assisted development is a plus.

- Identity & Detection: You have practical experience with Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM, as well as solid knowledge of network security, SIEM, and detection engineering.

- Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Ideally, you have experience with traditional or AI-assisted penetration testing and with tools such as Tenable or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.

- Hands-On Mindset: You do not just design security controls -you implement and operate them in practice. When you identify a problem, you do not wait for a ticket; you take ownership and develop a solution.

- Collaboration & Communication: You share knowledge and responsibility and work closely with the team on areas of joint ownership. You communicate confidently and professionally in English. German is a plus, but not a requirement.

Experience with an ongoing cloud migration and AI/LLM security is welcome, but not essential. What matters to us is what you can genuinely do - substance beats buzzword bingo.

Your Winning Deal 

- Your Benefits: In addition to 30 days of annual leave , we offer a monthly lunch allowance of €69 , a Givve Card topped up with €50 every month, or alternatively a subsidised Wellpass membership . You’ll also benefit from discounts through Corporate Benefits , the option to lease a JobRad bike , contributions towards occupational pension schemes and capital-forming benefits (bAV & VL) , as well as fantastic team and company events .

- Your Workplace: Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working model , combining work from one of our modern, dog-friendly offices with the flexibility to work remotely. You’ll also have the opportunity to enjoy up to two weeks of workation per year within the EU ( available only to employees holding an EU passport ).

title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
description:
Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on! 

Your role 

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. 

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. 

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust . 

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems. 

Your overall responsibilities include 

- Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code 

- Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop; 

- Taking ownership from discovery to post-production; 

- Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis; 

- Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices 

Who we are looking for 

In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters. 

Additionally, you tick the following boxes: 

- You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience. 

- You have previous experience in the payments domain. 

- You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment. 

- You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases. 

- You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka. 

- You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build. 

- You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket. 

- You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement. 

- You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission. 

Nice to have 

- Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain. 

Join us in building a better future 

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place. 

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry! 

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure. 

Our benefits package includes: 

- Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation. 

- Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned). 

- A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities. 

- In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use. 

- 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. 

- Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree. 

- Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals. 

- Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations. 

- Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees. 

- Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice. 

Interested in making an impact? 

We would love to have a conversation with you! 

Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned. 

Here’s the next steps of the hiring process: 

- Screening call with Recruiter 

- Codility assignment and technical interview with our Engineers 

- Culture-fit conversation with the team 

- Closing Coffee Chat with our Head of Engineering / Director of Product & Engineering 

Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned! 

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. 

If you have questions or need further information regarding your application, please contact our recruitment team via fastned.nl

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Agile Robots SE is a high-tech startup based in Munich. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use, and affordable robotic solutions with safe human-robot interaction. 

We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform industries and redefine user experiences. 

Your Responsibilities

- 
Design and implement a robust REST API and WebRTC-based communication server running on embedded Linux robot hardware

- 
Expose and maintain a well-defined API layer consumed by browser-based clients, either desktop or mobile (layouting)

- 
Integrate the backend server with communication middleware (e.g. ROS2) to bridge robot internals and external consumers

- 
Own the server architecture end-to-end — including design, deployment, debugging, documentation, and release 

- 
Ensure API reliability, performance, and security within embedded Linux constraints 

- 
Collaborate with frontend and robotics software teams on interface contracts and integration

- 
Develop both rapid proof-of-concept implementations and production-grade server components

Essential Skills

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field • 5+ years of professional backend development experience

- 
Proficient in Python; working knowledge of C++ in a systems or robotics context

- 
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and real-time communication protocols (WebRTC)

- 
Experience with communication middleware (e.g. ROS2) and its underlying concepts (pub/sub, services, actions) 

- 
Experience deploying and operating backend services on embedded Linux systems as well as designing the frontend counterpart

-

- 
Strong debugging and fault analysis skills at the application and network level 

Beneficial Skills

- 
Familiarity with frontend technologies (browser-based UI/UX)

-

Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.

- 
Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.

- 
Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.

Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.

title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
description:
Who we are ? 

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.

A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.

Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.

Your main responsibilities will include : 

- Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification

- Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment.

Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated.

The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities.

Required qualifications and experience : the candidate must hold a five-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+5) or equivalent. Applications from candidates with a four-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+4) and at least four years’ professional experience, a three-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+3) and at least six years’ experience, or a two-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+2) and at least ten years’ experience will also be considered.

Why join us? 
You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from :

- 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT)

- flexible working hours (depending on department activity)

- 75% public transport pass reimbursement

- Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc.

- Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector

Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Please note: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector.

title: Data Engineer
description:

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting 

Smarkets runs one of the world’s most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We’re a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting - from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you’re ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

The Team 

The Data Team is responsible for taking the wealth of data that Smarkets generates and using it to drive insights which improve the business. Since Smarkets produces a huge amount of data - including sports event data, payments information, order flow and user analytics - there are many opportunities for the team to add real business value.

The team’s responsibilities currently span across three different areas:

- Data Engineering: development and maintenance of ETL pipelines, services and APIs, and data-related infrastructure like Redshift or BigQuery;

- Data Science and Machine Learning: data exploration, ML models training and ML Ops to extract new insights from data;

- Analytics and Reporting: creation of data models and dashboards as well as automation of reporting pipelines for different teams, stakeholders and third-parties.

In a typical week, a data engineer in the Data team would:

- Add a new python ETL pipeline that segments users interested in specific sports through analysing behaviour which streamlines and tailors marketing communications to those users;

- Develop a new endpoint to a Flask API, add unit tests, and deploy the new version of the API into our production Kubernetes cluster;

- Train and evaluate an ML model to identify certain user patterns and provide it as service to other engineering teams in a Flask API;

Team Tech Stack 

Our current technology stack primarily includes Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kafka, Python, Flask/FastAPI, Postgres, AWS Redshift, dbt, Google Bigquery, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, Kibana, Lightdash.

About the Role: 

You will work very closely with the Data team lead and the other team members who will be assisting you whenever needed, making your integration in the company as smooth as possible.

The Data team works in an organised way using Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and regular standups. You will find an environment where you have a clear engineering direction, can focus on your work and hone your skills as a data engineer through exciting projects. You will always be able to count on the support of many engineers across the company.

What you will do:

- Developing and maintaining our Data ETL pipelines, some of which are real-time. The pipelines are fundamental to helping teams and stakeholders understand and drive business direction. Data components can also be user facing e.g. sending notifications to users;

- Ensuring our data lake is kept in a healthy state, particularly our data warehouses: Redshift and Bigquery;

- Developing and maintaining Flask services and Postgres databases within the Data team to provide access to data or manage certain business entities relevant to Data.

- Assisting the different teams in the company with reporting, especially when it comes to automated reporting pipelines.

- Doing data exploration and training & deploying ML models used to perform different kinds of user segmentation, detect operational anomalies or estimate important business quantities. In particular maintain and improve our existing recommender service that provides users with suggestions on new sport competitions.

Role Requirements: 

What we are looking for in you:

- 3+ years of experience

- You have an understanding of developing ETL pipelines using Python frameworks such as luigi or airflow;

- You have experience with the development of Python-based REST APIs / services and their integration with databases (e.g. Postgres);

- You are familiar with the key tools of the Python data science stack, e.g. Pandas, Numpy and scikit-learn;

- Some experience with training and deploying ML models;

- You enjoy writing elegant, well-tested and maintainable code;

- You are a team player that enjoys contributing to the success of the team in a proactive and friendly environment;

- You have a bachelor’s in Computer Science, Math or equivalent field, or possess relevant experience.

Our Values 

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

- Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

- Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

- Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

- Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

- Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits 
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

- Stock Options: Vest over 4 years - your success is our success.

Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

- 
Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

- 
Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

The Opportunity 

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions.

Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices.

You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

- Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow

- Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost

- Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution

- Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance

- Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead

- Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind

- Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains

- Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management

What Success Looks Like 

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

- Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency

- Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work

- Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making

- Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows

- Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams
