title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

- Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.

- Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

- Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).

- CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).

- Multilingual WordPress sites.

- A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.

- UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. title: Backend Engineer, Knowledge Graph
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada; Remote, United States

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.

The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.

In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). title: Product Engineer (Growth) // AI Music Video Platform
description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $6M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize their content and promote it online. The next target is a $15M run rate.

We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. You'll own our marketing pages and the surfaces that turn attention into revenue: free tools, landing pages, signup, onboarding, paywalls, and pricing. You'll also ship on the core product itself. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build.

This is a builder role. You'll ship production code daily, look at the results, decide what to test next, and be one of the people most directly responsible for taking us from $6M to $15M and ultimately to $100M.

As a profitable company, there is no VC drama. We are a small, ambitious group of people striving to build something creators love.

Tasks 

- Own our marketing pages: build, maintain, and continuously improve the landing pages and site experiences that bring people into Neural Frames, and keep them fast, high-converting, and visible in traditional search, Google AI Overviews, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

- Turn our free tools into real product entry points, where users get immediate value and then continue into Neural Frames without losing their song, lyrics, artwork, or progress

- Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing

- Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us

- Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines

- Build lifecycle experiments tied to real product behavior: activation, abandoned projects, paywall recovery, feature discovery, re-engagement

- Make sure our Conversion Tracking is set up correctly

- Own growth measurement and data quality across PostHog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and our backend payment data: build funnels and dashboards you can trust, investigate unexpected movements, and turn them into decisions

Requirements 

- You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish

- You're comfortable moving into backend and data work when necessary. Our backend is written in Python, and you can work with APIs, SQL, event data, and attribution logic

- You think like a marketer as much as an engineer: you have real opinions about headlines, page structure, and pricing pages, and you'd rather be measured on signups and revenue than on tickets closed

- You think through the complete funnel. A page that ranks is not a win if visitors don't activate, pay, and stick around

- You understand experimentation: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and a decision threshold defined before the test goes live

- You have strong product and editorial judgment. You build useful experiences for humans rather than filling the internet with generic AI-generated pages

- You use AI tools as a genuine extension of how you work, with a high bar for accuracy, originality, and brand quality

- You have high agency: you identify the bottleneck, gather the evidence, ship a solution, and communicate results without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket

- You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

- You've personally built something that produced meaningful organic or product-led growth: a startup, a free tool, a programmatic SEO engine, or growth ownership at a product company. We care more about attributable revenue than impressive traffic screenshots

- You know technical SEO well: crawling, indexing, structured data, internal linking, canonicalization, and safe migrations

Benefits 

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description:
Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. 

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen? 

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

- Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

- Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

- Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

- Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen 

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

- KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

- Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

- Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

- Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

- Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

- Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

- Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is 

- Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

- Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

- Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team 

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk 

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

- Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

- AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

- adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team 

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ228R125

As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform .

You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.

This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria & Eastern Europe.

The impact you will have 

- Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks. Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.

- Design production-grade agent systems. Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog

- Make agent quality measurable. Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.

- Govern AI at enterprise scale. Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.

- Scale your expertise. Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures. 

- Influence the product. Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.

- Be a visible voice. Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.

What we look for 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).

- A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production , not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.

- Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.

- Strong practical experience evaluating GenAI systems : tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.

- Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.

- Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.

- Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.

- Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.

- Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.

- Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.

- Communication: Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
description:
About Cantina: 

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role: 

We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale.

What You’ll Do: 

- 
Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines.

- 
Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision.

- 
Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end.

- 
Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code.

- 
Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases.

- 
Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request.

- 
Partner with research to productionize new models.

What You’ll Bring: 

- 
Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs.

- 
Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected.

- 
GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization.

- 
Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling.

- 
Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking.

- 
Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion).

- 
Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server.

Compensation: 

When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits for U.S.-based roles: 

- 
Competitive salary and generous company equity

- 
Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

- 
42 days of paid time off, including:

- 
15 PTO days

- 
10 sick days

- 
15 company holidays

- 
2 floating holidays

- 
Generous parental leave & fertility support

- 
401(k) retirement savings plan

- 
Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

- 
Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

- 
One Medical membership, and more!

Skills & experience 

Required

- Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. 

- Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking.

- Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices.

- Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. 

- Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. 

- Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity.

Nice to Have

- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.

- Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling.

- Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. 

- Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. 

- Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. 

Our AI Mindset 

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization.

As a Growth Operations Engineer at Peerspace, you will be the driving force behind scaling and optimizing our operational infrastructure through systematic innovation and growth hacking. This role sits at the critical intersection of business operations, process optimization, and technical automation. You will architect and implement scalable solutions that transform our customer operations, trust and safety, and sales workflows from manual processes into efficient, automated systems. Your mission is to identify operational bottlenecks, design data-driven solutions, and build robust technical infrastructure that enables exponential growth while maintaining service quality.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and deploy systems that not only streamline current operations but also create new capabilities for rapid scaling. Your work will directly impact our ability to handle increasing customer volume while reducing operational costs and improving team efficiency through smart automation and process optimization.

Responsibilities: 

- 
Systems Integration: Design, implement, and maintain integrations between key operational systems and our product infrastructure. Create automated workflows that enhance efficiency and data accuracy across platforms.

- 
Technical Support Infrastructure: Develop and optimize internal tools that empower our customer support and trust & safety teams to respond faster and more effectively to user needs. This includes building custom solutions for case management, automated responses, and support analytics.

- 
AI Implementation: Architect and implement AI-powered solutions to enhance customer support efficiency, including automated response systems, intelligent ticket routing, and predictive analytics for customer issues.

- 
Data Analytics: Create and maintain dashboards and reporting systems that provide real-time insights into customer support metrics, team performance, and system health. Use data to identify areas for automation and improvement.

- 
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of support systems with our core product. Partner with customer success and trust & safety teams to understand their needs and implement effective solutions.

- 
Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve support workflows, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency gains through technical solutions.

Requirements: 

- 
Technical Skills: Strong programming experience with proficiency in SQL and at least one modern programming language (Python, JavaScript, etc.). Experience with Laravel and Nuxt/Vue preferred. Experience with API integrations and webhook implementations.

- 
Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with customer support platforms (Intercom preferred), CRM systems, and ancillary software (MixMax, Zapier, Outreach, etc). Understanding of modern SaaS architecture and integration patterns.

- 
LLM/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI platforms and their practical applications in customer support contexts. Experience implementing and managing AI-powered solutions is a plus.

- 
Operations Background: 3+ years of experience in technical operations, customer operations, or similar roles where you've built or maintained support systems at scale.

- 
Analysis & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and visualization tools. Ability to translate complex operational problems into technical solutions.

- 
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- 
Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer support operations and how technology can enhance the customer experience.

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA

URL: https://vertican.com 

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required 

- 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

- Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

- Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.

- Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.

- You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.

- Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.

- Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have 

- Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.

- Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.

- Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.

- Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.

- Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

- A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.

- Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description:
Software Engineer, Data Integration

In Brief 

- 
We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

- 
Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are 

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. 

What you’ll do 

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities 

- 
Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.

- 
Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

- 
Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

- 
Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

- 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications 

- 
BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

- 
3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)

- 
Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.

- 
Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

- 
Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems

- 
Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications 

- 
Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.

- 
Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

- 
Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

- 
Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

- 
Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

- 
Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

- 
Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

- 
Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

- 
Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

- 
Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

- 
Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

- 
Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

- 
Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

- 
Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

- 
Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

- 
Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

- 
Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

- 
Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

- 
Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

- 
Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

- 
Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- 
Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

- 
Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

- 
Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

- 
Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

- 
3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

- 
Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

- 
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

- 
Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

- 
Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

- 
Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical 

- 
Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

- 
NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

- 
Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

- 
Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

- 
Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

- 
Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset 

- 
Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

- 
Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

- 
AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

- 
Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

- 
Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

What You'll Work With

- 
Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

- 
NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

- 
ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

- 
Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

- 
AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

- 
Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

- 
Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

Why Join Coalition Technologies? 

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

Office Assistant Responsibilities 

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

- Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

Required Skills and Qualifications 

The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

Preferred Skills 

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

Remote Work Environment 

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

Growth Opportunity 

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

Compensation 

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Software Engineer, New Grad
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer, New Grad

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you’ll help us build the future of on-demand delivery, contributing to the services that power our global marketplace. 

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining a high-impact engineering team at our London headquarters. As a New Grad, you will work on production systems that impact millions of users, supported by a world-class team of engineers.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: 

- Ship high-quality code: Improve code structure and contribute to the architecture of services using languages like Go, Ruby, Python, or Scala.

- Own your features: Take ownership of specific pieces of work, assisting with design, technical implementation, and influencing your team's roadmap.

- Operational excellence: Aim to simplify the maintenance and health of production systems, ensuring operational readiness and visibility.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Build relationships with other engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and solve complex marketplace problems.

- Grow through mentorship: Benefit from the support of senior colleagues while eventually supporting the growth of your peers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Foundational Knowledge: A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (graduated within the last year).

- Software Craftsmanship: Pride in writing readable, well-designed, and thoroughly tested software.

- Technical Curiosity: Experience writing web-based applications in any language and a strong interest in learning our stack (Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, or Rust).

- Data Fundamentals: Familiarity with relational databases (such as PostgreSQL or MySQL).

- Problem Solving: A proven ability to break down complex logistical or technical problems into manageable software solutions.

- Right to Work: Applicants must be authorised to work in the U.K. to be considered for this position.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

- 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

- 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

- 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

- 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog .

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

title: AI Developer
description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

- Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
- Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
- Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
- Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
- Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
- Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.
DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
- Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
- Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
- Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
- Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).

- 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
- Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
- Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
- DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
- Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

title: Operations Engineer, BizTech
description:

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. 

A Typical Day: 

- Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect

All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

- Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
description:
Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist , you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

You will work in founder and product mode : you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

- Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

- Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

- Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

- Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

- CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

- Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

- Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone . What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect. 

What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:
