How You'll Make an Impact: 

Thailand is one of Cloudbeds’ largest and most important markets, and Thai hoteliers run on an integration stack most of the world never sees. Hundreds of our largest Thai properties depend on these connections every day, and when one breaks, a front desk agent stops being a host and servicing guests.

As our Integrations Developer in Thailand, you’ll be the engineer who makes that stack reliable. You’ll work hand in hand with our long-standing local integration partner, MecX Tech, and with Cloudbeds’ Integrations Product and Engineering teams, to diagnose and fix integration issues at the code level, harden the integrations our customers rely on most, and design and build new integrations for the Thai market.

This is a hands-on build role with a customer-facing edge. You’ll own the hardest technical escalations, ship the fixes, and then build the tooling, monitoring and documentation that stop the same problem from coming back. You’ll champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission by using AI-assisted development and automation to move fast, so more of your time goes to the problems that genuinely need an engineer.

Our Integrations Team 

Cloudbeds connects to hundreds of partners across payments, accounting, distribution, access control, guest experience and government reporting. Our Integrations Product and Engineering teams design those connections, our partners build on our Open API, and our Customer Success team makes sure hoteliers get the outcome they were promised. You’ll sit at the center of all three for the Thai market, with a direct line into how integrations are prioritized, built and supported across APAC.

What You Bring to the Team 

- Own the Thai Integration Stack Technically: Become the engineering subject matter expert on our Thailand integrations, starting with the MecX Tech portfolio: accounting (Carmen, FlowAccount), government guest reporting (TM30 / RR4), local payment gateways, door locks, ID and passport readers, and POS.

- Fix It at the Source: Investigate integration failures end to end, across Cloudbeds APIs and webhooks, partner services, logs and data, and ship code-level fixes rather than workarounds. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Support and Onboarding on these integrations.

- Partner Engineering Liaison: Work day-to-day with MecX Tech and other Thai development partners as a technical peer: joint debugging, code and design reviews, shared issue logs, release coordination, and clear technical specs for partner-built work.

- Harden and Modernize: Help bring the most business-critical integrations onto Cloudbeds-managed infrastructure and source control, with proper deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting, so issues are caught before a hotelier has to report them.

- Debug and Diagnose: Use your knowledge of C# to debug and diagnose issues within existing integrations, validate fixes with real customers, and build monitoring and tooling to keep things working smoothly.

- Build Support Tooling: Create the diagnostic tools, runbooks, and dashboards that let Support and Onboarding resolve common integration issues without escalating to you.

- Close the Loop with Product: Turn recurring field issues into well-evidenced bug reports, API improvement requests and product feedback. Advocate for the Thai market inside Cloudbeds.

- Document Everything: Keep technical documentation, architecture notes, and knowledge base content current in both English and Thai.

What Sets You Up for Success 

- Real Integration Engineering Depth: 4+ years building and supporting production integrations between third-party systems: REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML payloads, data mapping, retries and error handling.

- Solid Backend Skills: Professional experience with C# and MySQL is a must. Python, JAVA, PHP, JS are a big plus. You must be comfortable reading and debugging code you didn’t write.

- Production Ownership: Experience with cloud hosting (AWS preferred), Git-based workflows, CI/CD, logging and monitoring. You’ve been on the hook for something that had to keep running.

- Show Strong AI Smarts: You use AI coding and debugging tools as part of how you work, pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, and look for ways to automate the repetitive.

- Hospitality: Experience with hotel technology, such as PMS, channel managers, payment gateways, POS, door locks or hotel accounting systems. Understanding night audit, revenue posting and how a hotel closes its day is a major plus.

- Thai Market Fluency: Native or business-fluent Thai plus strong professional English . You can debug with a Thai partner’s developers in the morning and write a clear technical design for a global engineering team in the afternoon.

- Works Independently: You are comfortable as the senior technical person in your time zone, set your own priorities, and know when and how to escalate.

- Clear Communicator: Able to explain technical root causes and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, support agents, and non-technical hotel staff alike.

- Inclusive Outlook: Comfortable working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds across many time zones.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out 

- Direct experience with Carmen Software, FlowAccount, or another hotel back-office or accounting platform.

- Hands-on experience with TM30 / RR4 or other government guest reporting integrations.

- Experience integrating Thai or APAC payment gateways (for example, 2C2P, KBank, SCB, KTB, PromptPay).

- Experience with Windows-hosted services, desktop agents, or on-premises hardware integrations (door locks, ID readers, POS).

- Prior experience at or with a Thai hospitality technology partner, reseller, or system integrator.

- Experience with the Cloudbeds Open API or another PMS API.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. title: Stage - Project Manager & Automation (F/H) - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Horizon Trading Solutions est une FinTech internationale indépendante, spécialisée dans les technologies de trading électronique multi-actifs depuis plus de 20 ans. Avec environ 160 collaborateurs répartis entre Paris, Rennes, Nantes, Montréal, Dubaï, Hong Kong, Bangkok et Singapour , nous accompagnons les institutions financières dans l'optimisation de leurs activités de trading grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Certifiée B Corp , Horizon s'engage en faveur d'une innovation responsable et a été récompensée à plusieurs reprises pour ses solutions, notamment avec le prix Best Sell-Side OMS 2025 .

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en automatisation et gestion de projet pour rejoindre notre équipe Client Delivery Management (CDM) , dans le cadre d'un stage de 6 mois, avec un démarrage possible entre février et avril 2027 .

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane , une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.

Votre mission sera de développer des solutions d'automatisation, d'optimiser les processus existants et d'intégrer Rocketlane à nos outils internes , afin de simplifier le quotidien de nos chefs de projet, de fiabiliser le suivi des activités et de réduire les tâches répétitives.

Ce stage vous permettra d'évoluer à l'intersection de la technologie, de la gestion de projet et des marchés financiers , en participant à des projets concrets dans un environnement international.

Vos missions

- 
Analyse et optimisation des processus : Étudier l'utilisation actuelle de Rocketlane et identifier les tâches manuelles pouvant être automatisées : création de projets à partir de modèles, relances, mises à jour de statuts et reporting.

- 
Développement et automatisation : Concevoir et développer des scripts et des automatisations, notamment en Python, en exploitant les API et les webhooks de Rocketlane.

- 
Intégration des outils : Améliorer l'interconnexion entre Rocketlane et nos outils internes (ticketing, support, documentation, annuaires clients) afin de limiter les doubles saisies et de fluidifier le partage d'informations.

- 
Suivi et reporting : Contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord, d'indicateurs de performance et d'outils de suivi des projets.

- 
Participation aux projets clients : Prendre part à des projets d'onboarding réels pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels, notamment les tests de connexion, la configuration des workflows de trading et la documentation.

- 
Collaboration transverse : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Client Delivery, Développement, Support et Produit pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Profil recherché

- 
Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs) en informatique, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine équivalent.

- 
Tu disposes de bonnes bases en programmation , idéalement en Python, et tu comprends le fonctionnement des API. Des connaissances en webhooks ou en outils d'automatisation sont un plus.

- 
Tu es à l'aise aussi bien sur les aspects techniques (programmation, intégrations, automatisation) que fonctionnels (gestion de projet, processus métiers, besoins clients).

- 
Tu maîtrises le français et l'anglais , à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu es à l'aise pour communiquer dans un environnement international.

- 
Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se), autonome et doté(e) d'un bon esprit analytique . Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement des outils, identifier des pistes d'amélioration et proposer des solutions concrètes.

- 
Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, techniques comme fonctionnels.

- 
Tu t'intéresses aux nouvelles technologies et aux marchés financiers , et tu souhaites découvrir les enjeux du trading électronique dans un environnement FinTech.

Ce que nous vous offrons

- 
Un projet concret et responsabilisant : Contribuez directement à l'amélioration des processus et des outils utilisés quotidiennement par notre équipe Client Delivery.

- 
Une expérience technique et fonctionnelle : Développez vos compétences en programmation, automatisation, intégration d'API et gestion de projet dans un environnement FinTech.

- 
Un environnement international : Échangez avec des collaborateurs et des équipes répartis en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.

- 
Un accompagnement personnalisé : Travaillez aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et développez vos compétences sur des problématiques réelles.

- 
Une culture collaborative : Rejoignez une entreprise à taille humaine, innovante et multiculturelle, où les initiatives et les idées sont encouragées.

- 

Une gratification de stage comprise entre 1 300 € et 1 700 € brut par mois , selon votre profil conformément à la politique de l'entreprise.

title: Satellite Systems Engineer
description:

Loft Orbital builds a space infrastructure providing a fast & simple path to orbit. Using different flight proven buses, we design, integrate and operate spacecrafts, to fly physical or virtual customers payloads. As a Satellite Systems Engineer at Loft, you will work on one or several satellite missions simultaneously, each one flying a single/multi-payload configuration. You will be a technical reference for these missions, working closely with program manager and all the Loft teams: products development teams, flight and ground software, AIT and operations.

Using flight proven satellite buses and Loft designed payload hub infrastructure, you will lead the development activities of the missions you are in charge of.

- Assist with program management and product management, including interfacing with customers on programmatic and schedule matters

- Review test plans and test results, and participate in the integration, test campaign, launch and in-orbit activities 

- Accommodate customer missions on Loft’s rideshare programs, contributing to satellite-level budgets and analyses, V&V planning, CONOPS definition, AIT, and on-orbit operations.

Nice to Haves:

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. 

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

title: AI Automation Intern, Communications
description:
Who We Are 

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role 

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases 

1. Media monitoring platform 

- Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

- Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

- Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

- Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam 

- Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

- Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

- Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

- Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking 

- Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

- Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

- Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

- Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like 

- First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

- By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring 

- A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

- A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

- Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have 

- Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

- Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

- Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.

Why Prosus? 

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. 

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . 

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment 

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values .

Hey, wir sind Sunlab – schön, dass du vorbeischaust.

Perfekt. Genau danach suchen wir!

Wir bei Sunlab verbinden Performance Marketing mit Technologie. Unser Inhouse-Development entwickelt individuelle Tools, intelligente Automatisierungen und technische Lösungen, die Prozesse optimieren und den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern.

Dabei verschmilzt die künstliche Intelligenz mit unserer DNA. Ob im Terminal oder OpenCode, Visual Studio Code, etc., unser Stack basiert aktuell auf Claude, OpenAI und einer lokalen LLM (Nvidia Spark).

Um unsere Mission weiter voranzubringen, suchen wir dich als
AI Software Developer (m/w/d). 

Dein Verantwortungsbereich 

- Agentic Coding: Du setzt LLMs ein um hochwertigen Code effizient zu entwickeln, bestehende Anwendungen zu erweitern und neue Features umzusetzen ohne dabei per Hand Code zu schreiben.

- Vom Prompt zum Produkt: Du machst aus Anforderungen und Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen. Dabei setzt du KI gezielt für Architektur, Implementierung, Debugging, Refactoring und Testing ein.

- Intelligente Automatisierung: Du identifizierst Prozesse, die sich mit KI und Code automatisieren lassen, und entwickelst dafür pragmatische, skalierbare Lösungen.

- KI-Integration: Du integrierst LLMs und passende APIs in bestehende Systeme und entwickelst beispielsweise intelligente Assistenten, datengetriebene Tools oder automatisierte Workflows.

- Qualität statt blindem Vertrauen: Du überprüfst KI-generierten Code, erkennst Schwachstellen und stellst sicher, dass deine Lösungen performant, wartbar und sicher sind.

- Tech-Stack weiterdenken: Du testest neue KI-Tools und Entwicklungsansätze, bewertest ihren praktischen Nutzen und bringst die besten Lösungen in unseren Arbeitsalltag.

- Know-how teilen: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team neue Standards für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung und hilfst dabei, das gesamte Team effizienter zu machen.

Dein Background 

- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit fundiertem IT- und KI-Schwerpunkt und kannst eigenständig sauberen, funktionierenden Code schreiben – unabhängig davon, ob du dabei KI einsetzt oder klassisch entwickelst.

- Du nutzt KI-Coding-Tools bereits aktiv und weißt, wie du sie für komplexere Entwicklungsaufgaben einsetzt.

- Du kennst dich mit mindestens einer relevanten Programmiersprache aus, beispielsweise .NET/C#, Rust, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache.

- APIs, Datenbanken, Git und grundlegende Softwarearchitektur sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.

- Du verstehst, dass KI-generierter Code nicht automatisch guter Code ist, und kannst Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen, testen und verbessern.

description:

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements 

- 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
- Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
- Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
- Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust

title: Senior Structural Analysis Engineer
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: 

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer in Toulouse. 

About the role: 

As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within Pangea Propulsion’s Structural Analysis team, operating with autonomy on thermomechanical, dynamic, and nonlinear structural problems.

You will own analysis campaigns end-to-end: from problem framing, modelling, validation, to results interpretation and design recommendations - directly influencing the architecture, performance, and robustness of the next generation of propulsion systems.

Within the team, you will serve as a technical reference point for advanced structural analysis methods , help shape internal best practices, and elevate the quality of analyses across projects.

A core part of your role will be coaching and guiding junior and consolidated analysts, transferring knowledge, reviewing technical work, and contributing to a high-performance engineering culture.

In this position, you will also take ownership of complex structural analysis problems and contribute to defining modelling strategies and analysis standards for the team. 

Familiarity with rocket propulsion hardware - or strong motivation to learn - will allow you to make an immediate impact.

Key responsibilities 

· Perform and lead FEA campaigns including static, modal, thermo-mechanical, dynamic and transient analyses, dealing efficiently with non-linear problems (contacts, plasticity, large deformation etc.)

· Plan, build, verify, document and maintain high-fidelity and robust FE models with traceability to loads, material properties, requirements, and assumptions.

· Provide clear, high-impact design feedback to mechanical design and propulsion teams at both part and subsystem level.

· Develop and improve analysis methodologies, scripts, subroutines, benchmarks, and guidelines.

· Lead cross disciplinary interactions with mechanical design, fluidic analysis, and test teams to ensure coherent modelling strategies and proper load mapping.

· Participate in design reviews, presenting methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations with clarity, conciseness and technical rigor.

· Mentor junior and consolidated engineers, helping them develop modelling skills, physics intuition, validation strategies, and efficient workflows.

· Review and challenge analysis approaches to ensure modelling robustness and consistency across projects. 

What you need to be successful 

· Experience in the aviation or space industry is strongly preferred.

· Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines.

· Minimum 5+ years of professional experience performing advanced structural analyses using commercial FEA tools (preferably Abaqus).

· Proven ability to run non-linear, thermo-mechanical, and dynamic analyses with a high level of autonomy and technical ownership. 

· Strong understanding of structural mechanics, vibrations, fatigue, fracture, material behavior, and numerical methods.

· Demonstrated experience framing analysis problems, defining assumptions, and ensuring consistency with loads and system requirements.

· Ability to interpret results critically, identify anomalies, and propose sound engineering solutions.

· Excellent communication skills—able to articulate assumptions, limitations, and design implications clearly to multidisciplinary teams.

· Proactive mindset, ownership attitude, and passion for sharing knowledge and elevating team capability.

· Fluent English.

Other useful skills 

· Experience in any of the following topics: fatigue (high cycle and low cycle), fracture mechanics, rotodynamics, test-correlation, topology optimization or probabilistic structural methods.

· Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc.

· Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB).

· Experience writing Abaqus subroutines (UMAT, USDFLD, UEL, etc.).

· Experience working with ECSS, AIAA and other aerospace structural verification standards.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Aerospace, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

description:

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About your role 

As the Director, Engineering you will lead the vision and execution for the foundational systems that power our entire engineering organization. Your mandate spans four critical pillars: architecting the modularization of our core Python/FastAPI monolith, accelerating our transition to an AI-native engineering culture, empowering product teams with tools to build AI-enabled features, and establishing a robust Application Security (AppSec) posture.

You will manage a group of engineering managers and staff engineers. You will act as a strategic multiplier for the company, treating our internal platform as a top-tier product. Your ultimate goal is to create secure, high-velocity "paved paths" that make our product teams incredibly fast, while systematically reducing technical debt and security risks.

What you'll do 

- 
Direct the Monolith Evolution: Own the multi-year technical strategy to safely decouple our legacy Python/Jinja monolith into a modern, modular FastAPI architecture using Domain-Driven Design and zero-downtime database migration tactics.

- 
Drive the AI-Native SDLC: Champion the rollout and adoption of AI-assisted coding tools and AI-augmented workflows across the entire engineering organization, systematically measuring and improving developer productivity.

- 
Enable AI Feature Development: Treat the internal platform as a product. Guide the development of intuitive SDKs, data pipelines, and internal tools that reduce cognitive load and allow product engineers to easily integrate LLMs and build AI-powered features.

- 
Lead Application Security (AppSec): Champion a "shift-left" security culture. Embed secure coding practices, automated vulnerability scanning, and threat modeling directly into developer workflows, ensuring our core platform is resilient against modern threats.

- 
Oversee Core Shared Services: Drive the scale, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical systems, including Identity (AuthN/AuthZ, OAuth2, RBAC), Audit Logs, and high-throughput API & MCP Gateways.

- 
Navigate Org-Wide Boundaries: Negotiate complex refactoring timelines with Product leaders and collaborate seamlessly with other Engineering teams and DevOps to align our platform capabilities with infrastructure.

- 
Build a World-Class Organization: Recruit, mentor, and grow a high-performing organization of engineering managers and staff/principal engineers, fostering a culture of architectural pragmatism and deep developer empathy.

Qualifications 

- 
15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering leadership, including explicitly managing managers and leading multiple teams.

- 
High AI Fluency: Proven experience architecting systems that support AI features (LLMs, RAG, tool calling) and a track record of driving AI-assisted development tools (AI SDLC) across engineering teams.

- 
An executive track record of successfully guiding massive monolith-to-modular migrations and decoupling shared database schemas in high-traffic, business-critical environments.

- 
Deep strategic understanding of Application Security principles, Identity/Access Management (OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and modern API traffic management.

- 
Strong technical fluency in Python and FastAPI ecosystems, with the ability to guide Staff-level engineers through complex architectural decisions involving both modern APIs and legacy applications.

- 
Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, security, and AI trade-offs into business value.

title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions.

What will you do?

· Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data.

· Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets.

· Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations.

· Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions.

title: Developer - Web Development & UX
description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined. 

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans , so please apply for only one position and only once a year —if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans , we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers , don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, you will join an award-winning creative, marketing, and advertising agency supporting a diverse portfolio of multi-industry client accounts across digital experiences, print, web, email, and analytics.Operating across varied technical environments, you will serve as the hands-on technical engine delivering everything from new custom website builds, landing pages, and campaign microsites to responsive HTML email templates and marketing automation integrations.

This is not a visual page-builder or no-code role. You will step into a dynamic agency setting requiring genuine computer science fundamentals, strong legacy code comprehension, and sharp troubleshooting skills. You will take ownership of maintaining and modernizing inherited codebases—including sites built over a decade ago—while collaborating with creative and design teams to ensure that technical execution reflects high standards of usability, responsive architecture,and user experience.

Accountability 

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your success will be defined by your ability to reliably engineer, launch,maintain, and troubleshoot performant, responsive digital solutions across diverse client technical stacks and CMS platforms. 

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Website Development, CMS Architecture & New Builds

- Translate approved creative concepts, business requirements, and design specifications into clean, responsive, and maintainable web pages and websites.

- Build custom landing pages, campaign-specific microsites, and reusable component architectures across varied project scopes.

- Architect and maintain custom WordPress implementations using custom themes, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF),and Gutenberg blocks, while supporting existing page-builder instances (Divi, Elementor).

- Develop, configure, and maintain Drupal content structures, custom content types, taxonomy fields, and core modules.

- Support HubSpot CMS development, including custom landing pages, interactive forms, and marketing automation components.

- Execute pre-deployment testing, cross-browser validation, and responsive device testing to ensure launch readiness and seamless post-launch fixes.

Legacy Codebase Maintenance, Debugging & Troubleshooting

- Review, understand, and debug complex, unfamiliar inherited client codebases and legacy systems dating back over ten years.

- Investigate broken functionality, technical defects, layout regressions, and CMS-related conflicts without destabilizing existing features.

- Implement targeted patches, updates, and architectural refactors while preserving full backward compatibility with older hosting and software environments.

- Support ongoing site maintenance schedules, security updates, and plugin/module upgrades across an extensive multi-client roster.

- Maintain rigorous documentation around legacy system quirks, architectural dependencies, and technical remediation steps.

HTML Email Development & Campaign Integrations

- Code responsive, cross-client HTML email templates built from scratch to render consistently across major desktop and mobile email clients.

- Develop, test, and maintain email assets across specialized platforms including Stripo, Mailchimp, Constant Contact,and HubSpot Email.

- Troubleshoot rendering anomalies, client-specific CSS quirks, and formatting issues inherent to email platforms.

- Implement dynamic content, forms, and tracking mechanisms aligned with campaign requirements.

API Connections, Enterprise Coordination & UX Collaboration

- Connect websites and digital properties to external systems, CRMs, and third-party web services via REST APIs.

- Troubleshoot data flows, form endpoints, and webhook connections, documenting integration behavior and data mapping.

- Interface with external implementation partners and support scoping, dependencies, and technical oversight for enterprise platforms (including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, Adobe Experience Manager, and TYPO3).

- Partner with UI/UX designers and creative leads during project scoping to evaluate technical feasibility, identify potential usability roadblocks, and advocate for practical UX, intuitive navigation, and accessibility standards.

Multi-Client Technical Operations & Quality Assurance

- Manage multiple concurrent development tasks and shifting deadlines across distinct client environments with high autonomy.

- Conduct comprehensive end-to-end QA, functional testing, form validation, and performance audits to optimize page load speeds and responsiveness.

- Coordinate clear, structured technical handoffs and status tracking across project management tools to ensure operational continuity.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Chief Operating Officer and the Technical Director overseeing developer and studio operations, while coordinating closely with the Technical Requirements Lead to align on platform priorities and architecture. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate with cross-functional agency teams—including UI/UX designers,production artists, copywriters, project managers, and data analysts—while liaising with external platform specialists.

At Oceans , you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans , we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your vertical strength will be foundational web development and legacy CMS architecture, while your horizontal capabilities should span practical UX design collaboration, cross-platform technical troubleshooting, and multi-client project delivery.

To excel in this role, you should have:

- 
Foundational Experience : 4+ years of hands-on web development experience, demonstrating deep proficiency with HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript, and modern responsive design principles. Experience within an agency or multi-client setting is strongly preferred.

- 
Legacy Code & CMS Mastery: Demonstrated experience understanding, modifying, and debugging inherited or legacy codebases without documentation. Strong hands-on development expertise in WordPress (custom themes,ACF, Gutenberg) and practical exposure to Drupal.

- 
Email & Landing Page Platforms: Proven ability to hand-code responsive HTML emails across Stripo, Mailchimp,Constant Contact, and HubSpot, understanding platform-specific email client constraints.

- 
Systems, APIs & Integrations: Practical experience integrating third-party APIs, troubleshooting data connections,and managing forms across CMS and CRM ecosystems.

- 
Tooling & Workflow: Familiarity with collaborative tools and project management systems such as Microsoft Teams, Notion, Workfront, or Wrike, paired with structured version control workflows.

- 
Mindset & Problem-Solving: High autonomy, intellectual curiosity, patience when diagnosing obscure technical defects, and strong communication skills to explain technical realities to non-technical partners. Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools as an accelerator while maintaining complete independent ownership over code validity and debugging.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

- 
Legacy Code Debugging & Problem-Solving: How do you approach navigating, diagnosing, and fixing broken functionality in an undocumented codebase built over a decade ago?

- 
CMS Architecture & Custom Development: What is your methodology for building custom, maintainable WordPress themes and Drupal configurations beyond pre-built page builders?

- 
HTML Email Engineering: How do you handle cross-client rendering constraints, responsive styling, and fallback logic across varied email platforms?

- 
UX & Design Alignment: How do you collaborate with creative designers during scoping to balance visual ambition with technical feasibility, accessibility, and intuitive usability?

- 
Multi-Client Execution & Prioritization: How do you manage concurrent development priorities across multiple client accounts while ensuring delivery rigor and clean handoffs?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans . You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role , where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans 

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: 

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. 

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. 

About the role 

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

- Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
- Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
- Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.

The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities 

- Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
- Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
- Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python .
- Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
- Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
- Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
- Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
- Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
- Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.

What you need to be successful 

- Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field.
- Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python .
- Good understanding of: - Fluid mechanics
- Thermodynamics and heat transfer
- Numerical methods and computational modelling

- Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
- Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
- Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
- Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
- Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems .
- Fluent written and spoken English.

Soft Skills 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
- Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
- Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
- Good technical communication and documentation skills.
- Attention to detail and critical thinking.

Nice to have 

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required :

- Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
- Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
- Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
- Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
- Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
- Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
- Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
- Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
- Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
- Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
- Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.

Expected internship outcomes 

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

- A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
- An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool .
- A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads .
- Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
- Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.

Supervision and collaboration 

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us… 

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork : We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance : we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth : we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability : because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring : we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

title: Data Quality Analyst - CDI - F/H/X
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE 
- Au sein de l'équipe Stock data quality, en tant que Data Analyst et amélioration continue, vous serez en charge de monitorer quotidiennement les anomalies de data stock, de mener les actions palliatives, d’améliorer les outils de monitoring et d’identifier les anomalies récurrentes, de reporter votre activité à l’aide de KPI. Cette base permettra la mise en place des actions correctives identifiées au sein de l’équipe stock data quality en collaboration avec les équipes IT et business.

🎯 MISSIONS 
- 

Analyse : 

- Quotidiennement monitorer les outils en place pour s’assurer de la bonne propagation de la donnée stock.
- En cas d’alertes remontées par les outils de monitoring, analyser les origines des alertes.

- Proposer des outils additionnels pour renforcer le monitoring ou alerting.
- Réaliser des compte-rendus journaliers ou bi-hebdomadaires des écarts constatés pour alimenter la réflexion sur des actions correctives plus long-terme.
- Construire les KPIs de suivi de la qualité, les diffuser

Amélioration continue et gestion de projets : 

- Participer à l’identification des actions correctives
- Cadrer le périmètre de ces actions
- Construire un plan projet prenant en compte les delivery IT, la redéfinition des process, la conduite du changement
- Définir des KPIs permettant de mesurer les gains attendus.
- Communiquer sur l’avancement du projet, remonter les alertes 

👉 PRÉ REQUIS 
- Bonne connaissance de Google Sheet / Excel pour la réalisation de TCD, graphiques,...
- Maitrise SQL 
- Anglais courant
- Rigueur et autonomie / curiosité
- Pensée analytique et bon esprit de synthèse
- Force de proposition
- Bonne communication écrit et oral et bon relationnel
- Gestion de projet 

👉 LE PETIT PLUS 
- Metabase (souhaité)
- Power BI Microstrategy (souhaité)
- Machine learning
- Maîtrise d’autres langages de programmation comme Python, R ou SAS.
- Visualisation des données

✅ AVANTAGES 
- 👉 Prime variable 
- 👉 Participation aux bénéfices et plan d'intéressement 
- 👉Télétravail possible jusqu'à 2 jours/semaine 
- 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne 
- 👉Comité d’entreprise CE

❓ EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR L'ÉQUIPE 
- L’équipe Stock data quality a pour objectif de garantir la qualité de la donnée stock tout au du cycle de vie du stock : de sa création en entrepôt jusqu’à son exploitation dans les process aval : valorisation des stocks, inventory management,... et ce, pour l’ensemble des propriétés du stock: que ce soit la quantité, la propriété, l’âge du stock, la typologie des mouvements, …

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have 

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

- Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

- Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for 

- Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

- Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

- Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

- Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

- Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Staff Software Engineer - Alwin
description:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin , our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper? 

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 

What You Will Do: 

Results You Will Drive 

- Better audit outcomes: improve how accurately and reliably agents complete real audit tasks, with traceable results and human oversight.

- A faster, more efficient runtime: reduce execution time and cost while scaling to more complex workloads and larger customers.

- More capable teams: build foundations and feedback loops that multiple teams use to ship and improve agents faster.

Build & Ship 

- Write production code every week on the most complex and critical parts of Alwin

- Build proofs of concept for new agent capabilities, and take the ones that work all the way to production

- Champion experimentation and R&D : try emerging models and techniques, solve hard problems creatively, and turn promising ideas into reliable features

- Build shared capabilities that multiple teams adopt , and remain accountable for whether they make those teams faster and their products more reliable

- Contribute directly to the agent harness at the core of Alwin: the orchestration, tools, context and evaluation loops every agent runs on

- Anticipate where the platform needs to be in 12 to 18 months, and make design decisions now that minimize the cost of future change

Agents in Production 

- Build agents that are reliable in a regulated domain : grounding, evaluation before release, human-in-the-loop, traceability of every action

- Improve how teams build Alwin by establishing tooling and feedback loops that help them detect agent failures, prioritize improvements, prevent regressions and ship production-ready agents faster

- Jump into the hardest incidents across teams , resolve immediate problems and turn what you learn into lasting, systemic fixes

- Make the trade-offs between model cost, latency and accuracy explicit, and measure them in production

Lead by Example 

- Own ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across teams : define the problem, align on the trade-offs and prove the solution in code

- Set the standard for code quality, testing and security through your own code and reviews, aligned with OWASP GenAI 

- Drive AI-assisted engineering by example : try new tools, show what works and help teams adopt them

- Mentor senior engineers and grow future staff engineers by pairing, reviewing and building alongside them

- Work with Product to spot opportunities and differentiators against the competition, and shape the roadmap with what you have proven is possible

What You Bring: 

- 10+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade Python , and you still write a lot of code

- Deep hands-on experience building and shipping agentic or LLM systems in production yourself (control loops, tool calling, context engineering and evaluation), with evidence that your work improved quality, reliability, speed, cost or scale

- A track record of personally solving ambiguous, high-impact problems across teams . Your work delivered measurable results and produced systems or practices that others adopted

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and growing technical leadership beyond your own team

- Strong fundamentals in distributed systems , software architecture and data modeling on a major cloud platform 

- Experience with security, access control and auditability for enterprise or regulated customers

- Product sense : you know which technical bets matter for customers and the business, and have influenced product and engineering direction through evidence and clear trade-offs, without relying on formal authority

- Proficient with AI-assisted engineering , and experience driving its adoption beyond your own work

- Clear written and verbal communication, across time zones and with technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-Have 

- Building platforms that other teams and customers build on

- Multi-agent orchestration or durable, long-running workflows at scale

- Retrieval and knowledge systems , or document processing (OCR, classification, structured extraction)

- Working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, Solution Architects and GTM teams on enterprise rollouts

- Experience at a scale-up going through rapid growth

- Domain experience in audit, accounting or fintech 

What We Offer: 

- Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

- Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

- Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

title: Internship - Programming & Automation
description:
WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP 

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project 

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail.

We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side:

• Robot programming and automation — this position

• Mechanical design and integration — separate posting

The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running.

Your role 

If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you.

We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended.

Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it.

What you’ll do 

• Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it.

• Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time.

• Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong.

• Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable.

• Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

• Package captures with the metadata needed to make a calibration reproducible, and make the whole thing robust to failures mid-run.

• Build a simple operator-facing workflow: mount the rig, pick a profile, press go.

• Work closely with the mechanical intern — your requirements shape their fixture design, and their measurements shape your motion limits.

Who you are 

• You are enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, Computational Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar).

• You are strong in Python. C++ is a plus.

• You are comfortable with 3D geometry: rigid transforms, rotation representations, coordinate frames, and keeping your conventions straight when it is 6pm and nothing lines up.

• You are interested in robot programming specifically — motion, reachability, collisions, repeatability — and not only in the vision maths around it.

• You understand enough about how camera calibration works to reason about what makes a dataset good or useless. You do not need to be able to write the solver.

• You have worked with real sensors and real robots, and you have learned that they lie about timing.

• You care about reliability. An automated process that works four times out of five is not automated.

• You write code that another engineer can pick up and extend.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for software that moves physical hardware.

• You are independent, curious, organized, and resourceful.

• Linux does not scare you, and neither does a robot that moves the moment your code says move.

We care much more about what you have built and made work than about grades.

Nice to have 

These are strong pluses, but not strict requirements:

• ROS 2, MoveIt 2, tf2, and motion planning in practice

• Experience with industrial or collaborative arm SDKs (UFactory / xArm, UR, Franka), or motion control more generally

• Hands-on camera calibration experience: OpenCV, Kalibr, ChArUco or AprilTag targets, hand-eye calibration

• Multi-camera rigs, and the specific pain of calibrating cameras with little or no overlapping field of view

• Machine vision cameras: triggering and synchronisation, GenICam, exposure control, rolling versus global shutter

• Coverage or observability reasoning: understanding why some poses inform a parameter and others do not

• Simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

• Docker, CI, and the habit of writing tests before you need them

• Experience turning a research script into something an operator can actually use

Please include 

When applying, please include links, repositories, or writeups that show us you build things that work. For example:

• GitHub repositories, with a note on which parts you actually wrote

• robot arm or robot motion projects

• camera calibration, multi-view geometry, SLAM, or structure-from-motion work

• data capture pipelines, test automation, or anything that had to run unattended

• computer vision projects

• simulation work

• a short writeup of something that broke and how you found the cause

• anything that demonstrates hands-on technical ownership

If you have ever chased a calibration error you couldn’t explain, eventually traced it to a timestamp, and fixed it properly, you’ll probably fit right in.

Requirements 

• Enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, CSE, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar)

• Strong programming skills, Python at minimum

• Comfortable working in Linux

• Strong interest in robotics, automation, computer vision, or perception

• English proficiency

• Organized and proactive working style

What we offer 

• 1000 euro monthly compensation

• 10 vacation days during the internship period

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home 2 days per week where practical

• A direct and significant influence on highly innovative products

• The opportunity to work close to the hardware and the product, with fast iteration and tight feedback loops

• Full ownership of a self-contained system that the rest of the company will depend on

• A team environment where practical experimentation, learning, and ownership are expected

The application procedure 

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, website, portfolio, or any other source that gives us a clear impression of your background, technical skills, and hands-on experience.

• We will get back to you ASAP. If we think you could be a fit for the position, we will invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a more technically focused interview may follow.

• If at that point we believe you are the person we are looking for, we will discuss the specifics such as starting date and internship period.

Welcome to the team!
