title: Senior Full-Stack Growth Engineer - Marketing & Analytics
description:
About Truelogic 

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client 

A premier digital product and technology consulting firm specializing in modern software engineering, cloud-native architecture, and strategic digital transformation across high-impact sectors including healthcare, financial services, and education.

Job Summary 

The Senior Full-Stack Growth Engineer plays a pivotal role in designing, building, and evolving the technical infrastructure that powers customer acquisition, experimentation, and marketing performance. This unique position bridges end-to-end full-stack software development with rigorous quantitative analysis to drive measurable business impact. The ideal candidate will architect production features and internal tools, build resilient API and CRM integrations, instrument deep product analytics, and design statistically sound experiments across the entire user lifecycle. - 
Architect, build, and maintain production-ready full-stack features, backend services, web applications, and internal growth tools.

Design, deploy, and evaluate experiments across customer acquisition, onboarding flows, conversion funnels, and retention loops.

- 
Apply statistical inference and causal reasoning to evaluate A/B test results, identify confounding factors, and communicate uncertainty clearly to stakeholders.

- 
Implement robust event tracking, instrumentation, and product analytics using modern platforms (e.g., PostHog).

- 
Integrate advertising platforms, CRMs, databases, and third-party tools via REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and event-driven data pipelines.

- 
Evolve database schemas and analytical data models to support new product workflows, attribution, and reliable measurement.

- 
Connect acquisition, product usage, CRM, and revenue data streams to analyze full-funnel customer journeys and business outcomes.

- 
Maintain high standards for data quality, automated testing, observability, user privacy, and data security across all integrations.

- 
Collaborate with marketing, product, and design partners to translate strategic growth objectives into testable engineering roadmaps.

- 
Leverage modern AI-assisted engineering and analytical workflows responsibly, ensuring rigorous validation and data governance.

Qualifications and Job Requirements 

- 
Proven track record as a Full-Stack Software Engineer building modern web applications, scalable backend APIs, and working with relational databases.

- 
Advanced SQL proficiency alongside hands-on scripting/analytical experience in Python, R, or equivalent modern data tools.

- 
Practical foundation in experimental design, A/B testing methodologies, statistical inference, and causal reasoning.

- 
Hands-on experience implementing product analytics instrumentation, event pipelines, and auditing data quality.

- 
Solid experience architecting third-party integrations using webhooks, APIs, and event-driven patterns.

- 
Strong ability to translate complex data findings and technical tradeoffs into actionable business and product insights.

- 
Practical experience with AI-assisted software development and analytical tooling, backed by sound engineering judgment regarding validation and security.

Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- 
Familiarity with PostHog, CRM platforms, marketing automation engines, Conversion APIs (CAPI), or server-side tracking.

- 
Familiarity with growth metrics such as CAC, LTV, churn/retention curves, and ROAS.

- 
Understanding of incrementality testing, conversion lift studies, and attribution model nuances.

- 
Background in consulting, client-facing delivery, or building software in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare, fintech).

What We Offer 

- 
100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

- 
Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

- 
Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

- 
Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

- 
Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here 

- 
A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

- 
Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

- 
Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

title: Agentic AI Senior Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Switzerland. 

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.

Accountabilities: 

- Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.

- Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows.

- Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.

- Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.

- Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

- Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.

- Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.

- Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.

- Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.

- Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.

- Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations.

- Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles.

- Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation.

- Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements.

- Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities.

- Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization.

- Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

Requirements:

- At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).

- Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.

- Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.

- Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.

Our client is an established, family-owned industrial technology company headquartered near Zurich. Its systems run at customer sites in more than 60 countries. To keep them reachable and secure, it needs someone who can build and run the networks behind them, and who is comfortable intervening and troubleshooting when a customer's connection goes down.

What you'll do 

- Set up, run and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPNs to customer sites (IPsec, OpenVPN)

- Configure and maintain firewalls (Fortinet, OPNsense and others)

- Design and implement networks at customer sites: switching, routing, VLANs, WLAN

- Find and fix network problems together with customers and colleagues around the world, remotely or on site

- Install and roll out software on Windows and Linux systems

- Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

- Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works

What you bring 

- A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

- At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

- Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

- Real experience with VPNs, ideally IPsec and OpenVPN

- Working knowledge of Windows Server

- A calm, customer-focused way of solving problems, including under pressure

- Fluent German and English

- Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site work

Nice to have 

- Linux administration

- Scripting or automation (Python, Bash)

- Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or Fortinet NSE

- A background in network or cyber security

What's on offer 

- Room to shape the role and how things are done

- Flexible working model with home office (up to 60%) 

- Individual training and certification budget

- Comprehensive social benefits

- A long-term position in a stable, family-owned company

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Meet the team 

You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings . 

You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy. 

What you will do: 

- Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition. 

- Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information. 

- Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction. 

- Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets. 

- Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output. 

- Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation. 

- Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes. 

- Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity. 

- Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring. 

What you will need: 

- 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, Machine Learning, algorithm development, computer vision or related field. 

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Geospatial Science, Statistics or another quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is a plus. 

- Strong fundamentals in algorithms and machine learning , including model development, evaluation, statistics and experimental design. 

- Proficiency in Python , an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing tools such as Spark or Databricks. 

- Experience taking algorithms, ML models or data pipelines from experimentation into production . 

- Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues. 

- Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise. 

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently approach complex and ambiguous problems. 

- Proficient written and verbal communication skills in English. 

- You already live in the Netherlands. We cannot offer relocation for this role. 

What we offer 

A competitive compensation package, of course. 

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team 

We’re Maps, a global team within TomTom’s Location Technology Products technical unit. Our team is driven to deliver the most up-to-date, accurate and detailed maps for hundreds of millions of users around the world. Joining our team, you’ll continuously innovate our mapmaking processes, directly contributing to our vision: engineering the world's most trusted and useful map.

At TomTom... 

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

After you apply 

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs .

TomTom is an equal opportunity employer 

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you . No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised ~$60M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP , integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

- 
Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

- 
Expand our newer Infisical PKI , Infisical PAM , and Infisical KMS product lines.

- 
Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

Requirements 

- 
Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript (3+).

- 
Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

- 
A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

- 
Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

Nice to have 

- 
Expertise in Go.

- 
Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

- 
Previous founder or startup experience.

- 
Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

- 
Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

Team, values & benefits 

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role 

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

Responsibilities 

- Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

- Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

- Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

- Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

- Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

- New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

- Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

- Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

- System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

- Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

- Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

- Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have 

- Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

- Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

- Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

- Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

- Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

- Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Head of Investment Fund Operations
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Head of Fund Operations to oversee the operational management of a diverse Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio within an established international private banking environment.

In this responsible leadership role, you will manage a small team of fund operations specialists and ensure reliable, accurate and efficient processes across fund data, cost management, NAV controls and reporting. You will work closely with internal stakeholders as well as fund administrators, system providers, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. As a member of the Valuation Committee, you will also contribute your expertise to fund valuation-related decisions.

The position offers a combination of team leadership, fund operations expertise, data management, regulatory knowledge and process automation , with considerable scope to improve existing processes and further professionalise the operational setup.

Location: Basel

Your Responsibilities: 

- Manage and develop a team of three Fund Operations specialists and oversee operations for the complete Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- Ensure the availability, integrity and quality of fund data across the relevant internal systems

- Monitor end-to-end data flows and act as the key contact for the external system provider

- Review and validate important fund indicators such as TER, PTR, OGC and transaction costs

- Take ownership of the PRIIPs KID production process and ensure that the underlying information is accurate and up to date

- Manage the relationship with CACEIS concerning NAV data, including plausibility controls and the investigation and resolution of discrepancies

- Participate in valuation-related decisions as an active member of the Valuation Committee

- Coordinate the preparation and publication of annual and semi-annual fund reports

- Liaise with auditors and tax advisors and oversee relevant fund-related tax topics

- Review fund-related invoices and ensure transparency and accuracy of associated costs

- Coordinate the preparation of factsheets, monthly fund manager reports and regular reporting for wholesale clients

- Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, automation and data quality

- Drive the use of automation and data-driven approaches to improve fund operations and reporting

- Ensure that operational processes and reporting activities are aligned with applicable Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory requirements

- Serve as a knowledgeable and reliable contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers across fund operations

Your Profile: 

- At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in fund operations, fund controlling, fund accounting, fund administration or fund audit

- Comprehensive knowledge of the Swiss and Luxembourg fund landscape, ideally including CISA, FINMA, AMAS, UCITS and CSSF regulations

- Practical experience with NAV control and oversight and cooperation with external fund administrators

- Previous experience with CACEIS is considered an advantage

- Strong knowledge of fund reporting, data management, valuation processes and fund-related cost structures

- Good technical capabilities, including Python or a comparable scripting language, advanced Excel and experience working with databases and SQL

- Experience in automating operational, data or reporting processes is highly desirable

- Strong analytical skills and a precise, structured approach to complex data and processes

- A proactive, hands-on working style with a high degree of personal responsibility

- Previous leadership or people management experience is an advantage

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions and organisations

- High level of integrity, reliability and accountability

- Comfortable working in an international, regulated financial services environment

- University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

- Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

What We Offer: 

- A senior position with broad responsibility for the operational management of a Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- The opportunity to shape and further improve the Fund Operations function and its processes

- A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

- Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

- The opportunity to contribute to the Valuation Committee and support important fund-related decisions

- Significant scope to introduce process improvements and strengthen automation and data quality

- An international environment within an established and reputable private banking organisation

- Flexible working arrangements and a modern working environment

- Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

title: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)
description:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do: 

- Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions

- Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping

- Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing

- Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate

- Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes

- Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features

- Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships

- Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling

- Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns

- Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

- Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship

- Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team

- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality

- Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks

- Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

- Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

- Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

- A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

- A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

- An insatiable desire and ability to learn

- BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required: 

- Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

- Experience with Agile development

- Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

- Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

- Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: 

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters 
- Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations 
- Lead regional technical initiatives 
- Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support: 

- Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development 
- Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region. 
- Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings 

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance: 

- Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings 
- Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests 
- Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns 
- Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality 
- Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population 
- Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations. 

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison 

- Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units 
- Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests 
- Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends 
- Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria 
- Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence. 

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement 

- Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation 

- Provide Technical expertise on regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals 
- Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities 
- Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities 
- Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact 

Supervision & Autonomy 

- Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy 
- Works independently on technical matters 
- Expected to remain hands-on 
- Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives 
- Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership 

What You'll Need 

Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas: 

- Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries. 
- Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies. 
- Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise. 
- Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis. 
- Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas. 
- Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure. 
- Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data. 
- Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns. 
- Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains. 
- Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations. 
- Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination. 
- Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations. 
- Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities.

- Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.
- Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.
- Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.
- Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.
- Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.

Required

- Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.

- Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.
- Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.

description: Proxima Fusion | Senior Software Engineer (Dev Platform) | Munich, Germany | ONSITE | Full-time We're building the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. First spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, based on Wendelstein 7-X (the largest stellarator ever built), €650M+ raised, teams in Munich, Zurich and Oxford. Finding a good stellarator design means searching an enormous high-dimensional space, and every candidate design needs heavy plasma physics simulation. That's the compute problem this role owns: cloud + HPC clusters, K8s, Ray, Dask, and the platform work around it (CI/CD, IaC, observability). You'd sit directly next to the physicists and AI researchers burning through that compute, so you see exactly what your infrastructure unlocks. Python and Linux. If you've wanted to point your platform engineering skills at something that actually matters, clean, abundant energy, this is about as direct a shot as it gets, and it's happening in Europe. title: Role: UX/UI Designer (BAY AREA, CA - HYBRID) 1099 CONTRACT
company: Role: UX/UI Designer (BAY AREA, CA - HYBRID) 1099 CONTRACT
description:
Role: UX/UI Designer (BAY AREA, CA - HYBRID) 1099 CONTRACT
APPLY: https://vuetech.sh/careers Ongoing contract across several B2B products on one design system. First pass is a fixed-price flows-and-kit package, then hourly as each product grows. Not a full-time seat. Engagement: Ongoing 1099 contract. Milestone prices are set against a frozen spec. This is not a full-time seat. First package: A fixed-price flows-and-kit package, about three weeks. After that, $50–75/hr as each product grows. Location: SF Bay Area, hybrid, with in-person working sessions for kickoff and reviews. Start: Immediately after selection. Level: Mid-level welcome. You work directly with the founding CTO. Early sessions are for breaking the product down together. After that, scope is deliverable by deliverable. ABOUT THE STUDIO:
We are a small Bay Area product studio. Several products, one stack, one visual language. You own the UX with us: who the user is, what they are trying to finish, what belongs on each screen, and what happens when it fails. Later products reuse the same tokens, components, and patterns so customers and our engineers are not learning a new UI every time. The products are B2B web apps: dashboards, media and content libraries, status views, and auth and access-gate states. The first product in the queue is a digital signage CMS. Store owners upload content, build playlists, pair outdoor Android screens from a phone, and see what is playing. The app is a mobile-first PWA. The screen on the sidewalk has its own states: setup QR, downloading, no content, and error. You take a real part in that breakdown. Bring a point of view on structure, priority, and what to cut. Sit with us and map the flows before the high-fidelity screens exist. When a familiar admin layout is the wrong job for the task, say so and show the alternative. The screens still have to ship. We start from a Tailwind UI / shadcn component kit. Buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and dialogs stay that anatomy, restyled with our brand: color, type, radius, and density. Page structure, hierarchy, and flow are yours. Every screen is composed from those components, with tokens that map to our Tailwind theme, so the frontend team builds from the system. FOR MORE DETAILS OR TO APPLY: https://vuetech.sh/careers

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. 

About SkinVision 

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. 

DevOps at SkinVision 

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring. 

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence. 

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next. 

What you will do 

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation 

- Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

- Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. 

- Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines. 

- Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting. 

CI/CD & Deployment 

- Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments. 

- Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes. 

- Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes. 

- Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle. 

Observability & Monitoring 

- Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts. 

- Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance. 

- Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks. 

- Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems. 

Security & Compliance 

- Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines. 

- Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store). 

- Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA). 

- Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments. 

Reliability & Incident Management 

- Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues. 

- Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments. 

- Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance. 

- Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation. 

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture 

- Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve. 

- Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost. 

- Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations. 

- Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction. 

Essential skills 

- Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles. 

- Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.). 

- Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS 

- Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar). 

- Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting. 

- Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go. 

- Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. 

- Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration. 

- Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills. 

Desirable skills 

- Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech. 

- Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments. 

- Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS). 

- Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices. 

- Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS. 

Qualifications 

- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

- Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus. 

What we offer 

- A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy 

- A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam 

- An enthusiastic, professional, and international team 

- Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities 

- Unlimited skin checks for you

title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits 

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

- Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

- Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

- Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

- Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

- Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

- You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

- You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

- You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

- You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

- You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: Senior AI Engineer (AI Automation)
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be the embedded AI automation engineer for Product, building the agents, automations, and apps that help product managers, product marketers, and designers move faster. You work directly with them, and with engineering, across the product lifecycle from early discovery through launch and adoption. You sit inside the teams, not behind a ticket queue.

The impact you will have: 

- 
Move repetitive, manual work into agents and automations so Product, Product Marketing, and Design spend their time on judgment and customer work, not busywork.

- 
Give teams direct access to customer insight and the data behind it through the tools you build, so they make better-informed decisions.

- 
Ship agentic solutions teams actually adopt, so the same headcount operates at a scale it otherwise could not.

- 
Build reusable, maintained components so each new build is faster than the last and no one rebuilds what already exists.

- 
Turn a rough idea into a working prototype in hours and ship same-day production fixes to shared agents, driving faster speed to market across Product and Marketing.

What we’re looking for: 

- 
Strong software engineering in Python or TypeScript. You ship production code, not just workflows wired together.

- 
Very high AI fluency. You build with AI every day and build agentic solutions on current frontier models, including MCP, retrieval, evals, and observability. Show us something you built.

- 
Experience taking requirements from non-engineers and finding the need behind the ask.

- 
Judgment about where AI adds value and where it does not.

- 
Experience building solutions that non-technical teams adopted and kept using.

- 
Daily use of AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

- 
Senior scope: you own problems end to end, need little direction, and are comfortable with ambiguity.

About the Team: 

- 
AI Automation Engineering is the engineering home for internal tooling and agents, embedded with Product, Product Marketing, and Design.

- 
You stay connected to engineering for standards, code review, and shared infrastructure, so what you build holds up in production and compounds across teams.

- 
The work is high-ownership and ambiguous by design. You set your own priorities and own problems end to end.

- 
Globally distributed, fully remote, and async-first.

Team Operating Rhythms: 

- 
Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm PST.

- 
Embedded side by side with the teams you serve, with a connection back to the AI Automation team and engineering.

- 
Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

- 
No travel, no onsite, and no on-call.

Required online and collaboration hours: 

- 
Schedule: Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm CT.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- 
A rough idea becomes a working prototype in hours, so the team reacts to something real instead of a description.

- 
You ship an improvement to a shared agent or app to production the same day a user reports a problem.

- 
Within the first 90 days, a team relies on something you built as part of their weekly work.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- 
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- 
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- 
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- 
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- 
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- 
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- 
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- 
Accelerate repeatable workflows

- 
Structure and solve problems

- 
Improve output quality

- 
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- 
Priorities and targets to change quickly

- 
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- 
A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- 
Close collaboration across teams and functions

- 
Frequent, high-touch communication

- 
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- 
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- 
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- 
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people.
